grades.quote: Since kernelvec only executes if xv6 was already in the kernel, kernelvec can rely on satp being set to the kernel page table
grades.reason: The passage covers kernel-space traps (kernelvec/kerneltrap), not the user-trap entry satp switch. It never says what writing satp does and never mentions SFENCE.VMA or TLB synchronization. Its only link to the query is a remark that satp already holds the kernel page table once the kernel is running. That is limited background.
